lines.en: Six legs press through the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我的大颚先于身体出发。
lines.en: My mandibles arrive before the rest of me.
This armor of mine is heavy stuff.
Front legs clear the way; back legs follow.
There's a road under the leaf litter.
Each step sinks the soil a little deeper.
The berry taste is still from yesterday.
I walk along the grooves of a tree root.
However narrow it gets, I can squeeze through.
I push through the grass, leaf on my horns.
My plates click once against each other.
Farther on there's a proper tree.
I catch the sweet smell of rotting wood.
Easy now — I'd rather not tip over.

lines.zh: 我用大颚量了量这条缝。
lines.en: I measure the gap with my mandibles.

lines.zh: 树皮在我脚下碎成小块。
lines.en: Bark crumbles under my feet.
I rest my mandibles against the bark.
My shell shines in the midday sun.
I rub my front legs against each other.

lines.zh: 一只蚂蚁从我的角上爬过。
lines.en: An ant is walking over my horn.
I'm resting a while in this hollow.
My wings are folded beneath the plates.
When wind blows, I pose as dead wood.

lines.zh: 浆果的味道真让人安心。
lines.en: That berry flavor is a comforting thing.
I count the cracks running down the bark.
Something brushed against my antennae.
I filed a small notch in my mandible.
Staying put like this suits me best.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，看清了你的靴子。
lines.en: I look up and make out your boots.
Your hands smell of berries already.
I open my mandibles, then close them.
Are you the one bringing me berries?
I know those hands; they've fed me.
I tilt my whole body and study you.
I have to tilt my whole body to see you.
I raise my horn; it's only a greeting.

lines.zh: 你一侧身，阴影盖住甲壳。
lines.en: You turned, and shade fell across my armor.

lines.zh: 我在地上敲了两下回应。
lines.en: I tap the ground twice in reply.
Don't bring your fingers near my jaws.

lines.zh: 你身上有树叶和土的气味。
lines.en: You smell of leaves and turned soil.
I'm following. Which way are you going?
You've stared long; I'll stare back.
My shell cracked; I heard it happen.
Don't smash the plates on my back.
My horn is bent off to one side.
That hit landed harder than mine do.
I pull in my legs to guard my belly.
Everything under my shell hurts.
I can't stand steady; I swayed twice.
My wings are pinned underneath.
Who turned me onto my back?
I grit my teeth — though I have none.
Berries — I smell them on you.
Sweet and red. Don't hide it.

lines.zh: 我张开颚等着你放下来。
lines.en: I open my jaws and wait for you to set it down.
One berry is enough; I'm eating it.

lines.zh: 你握得太紧，果皮快破了。
lines.en: You're squeezing too hard; the skin's breaking.

lines.zh: 我往前挪，脚却绊了一下。
lines.en: I step forward and trip over my own legs.
That smell sets my wings trembling.
Eat this and I'll stand watch for you.
Sweet! Every part of me wakes up.
Don't leave yet; let me swallow first.

lines.zh: 我的角撞上了你的膝盖。
lines.en: My horn knocked into your knee.
Shell hit shell, and it rang loud.
I'm heavy; one bump and I can't stop.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我的角比眼睛先到。
lines.en: Sorry — my horn arrives before my eyes do.
You shoved me right around.
We're both hard-shelled; neither gives way.
I back off half a step and set my feet.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的角卡住了。
lines.en: That wedged my horn in place.
I'll go around the side of your foot.
Don't step there; my shell would crack.

lines.zh: 两只大颚对在一起比力气。
lines.en: Two sets of jaws meet to test their strength.

lines.zh: 我们在朽木上推来推去。
lines.en: We shove each other back and forth on the log.
Its horn is longer than mine.

lines.zh: 赢了才能留在这棵树上。
lines.en: The winner gets to keep this tree.
We clashed until our shells rang.
It raised its head; I stepped back.
Its scent is left on the wood below.
We hide our eggs inside the rotten wood.
It pushed me; I pushed right back.

lines.zh: 打完架，我们一起啃树皮。
lines.en: After the fight we chew bark side by side.
I clamp a berry between my jaws.
Too heavy — I drag it along the ground.
The red fruit is stuck on my horn.
I bury the fruit under fallen leaves.
I'll keep this one for later.
I push it back into the tree hollow.
Carrying it, my legs feel unsteady.
What a big one — two meals at least.
I dropped one; it rolled into the grass.
I'm bringing this one to my mate.
Something's moving up on that leaf.
I smell sap, and I want to go.

lines.zh: 前面那只虫挡了我的路。
lines.en: That bug ahead is blocking my path.
Something's coming up behind you.
I aim my horn in that direction.
I've marked that piece of rotten wood.
Who's digging under the tree?

lines.zh: 上面有翅膀扇动的声音。
lines.en: Wings are beating somewhere above me.

lines.zh: 我要去看看那颗倒下的树。
lines.en: I want to check that fallen tree.

lines.zh: 目标是我主人身后那个。
lines.en: My target is the one behind my keeper.
I lower my body and walk toward it.
A light click sounds between my jaws.
Three steps left between us.
No detour — I'll go straight through it.

lines.zh: 我的触须锁定了它的位置。
lines.en: My antennae have locked onto its spot.
If it backs off, I follow.
As long as my keeper stays behind me.
The wings under my plates have tensed.

lines.zh: 我一点点靠近那团影子。
lines.en: I close in on that shadow bit by bit.

lines.zh: 它的影子落在我角尖上。
lines.en: Its shadow falls on the tip of my horn.

lines.zh: 我用大颚夹住，再甩出去。
lines.en: I clamp down and fling it away.
That toss sent it flying backward.
My blow sent it sprawling backward.
I lift my horn and flick it aside.
It stood before my keeper. Not allowed.
My shove pushed it back four steps.

lines.zh: 颚一合，它就知道该走了。
lines.en: My jaws close once, and it gets the message.
I pin it down until it stops moving.
I put my whole body into that hit.
When it landed, a spray of dirt rose.
I chew my way out of the rotten log.

lines.zh: 刚蜕的壳还软，我先躲着。
lines.en: My freshly shed shell is soft; I'll hide awhile.

lines.zh: 这片林子有浆果，我留下。
lines.en: This woodland has berries. I'll stay.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖刚展开的翅膀。
lines.en: I shake out my newly opened wings.

lines.zh: 树根下面是我的第一站。
lines.en: Under the roots is my first stop.

lines.zh: 同伴在树皮上留了记号。
lines.en: A kin of mine left a mark on the bark.

lines.zh: 天刚亮，林子里全是露水。
lines.en: Dawn broke; the whole grove is dewy.

lines.zh: 我一出生就带着这对角。
lines.en: I was born with this pair of horns.

lines.zh: 朽木的味道告诉我到家了。
lines.en: The smell of rotten wood tells me I'm home.
Who carved letters into this tree?
My shell is hot as heated iron.
I fell horn-first into the leaves.
Water floods my plates; I'm sinking.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的壳掀开一条缝。
lines.en: The blast split a seam in my shell.
An arrow wedged into my armor's gap.
Violet light makes my legs go weak.
I'm forgetting what berries even taste like.

lines.zh: 雷劈在树上，我贴着地面。
lines.en: Lightning hit the tree; I pressed flat.

lines.zh: 底下空得没有一片叶子。
lines.en: Below there isn't a single leaf.
